stories.title: Saudi Arabia Outlines 3 Pathways to Explore Uranium Resources Locally

en.title: Saudi Arabia Outlines 3 Pathways to Explore Uranium Resources Locally
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has outlined three pathways for exploring uranium resources within the country.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defense lifts emergency alerts in southern regions

en.title: Saudi Civil Defense lifts emergency alerts in southern regions
en.summary: Saudi Civil Defense lifted all emergency alerts after resolving temporary danger warnings in four southern and southwestern regions including Jazan, Najran, Khamis Mushait, and Abha.

stories.title: IAEA chief says Saudi Arabia moving forward with nuclear power program, research reactor

en.title: IAEA chief says Saudi Arabia moving forward with nuclear power program, research reactor
en.summary: The IAEA Director General confirmed Saudi Arabia is advancing its nuclear power program and research reactor while maintaining strong non-proliferation commitments, with IAEA support.

stories.title: SR3.2 billion joint venture agreement inked to develop and deliver Riyadh Expo Village

en.title: SR3.2 billion joint venture agreement inked to develop and deliver Riyadh Expo Village
en.summary: Expo 2030 Riyadh and Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Company signed a 3.2 billion Saudi riyal joint venture agreement to develop the residential community for Expo 2030 Riyadh.

stories.title: Expo 2030 Riyadh signs $853m joint venture to develop Expo Village

en.title: Expo 2030 Riyadh signs $853m joint venture to develop Expo Village
en.summary: Expo 2030 Riyadh partnered with Mohammad Al-Habib Real Estate Co. on a $853 million joint venture to build an integrated residential community for 5,500 international delegates. The Expo Village will become a permanent residential area after the event concludes.

stories.title: Dammam Airports signs design deal to expand King Fahd International

en.title: Dammam Airports signs design deal to expand King Fahd International
en.summary: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam plans to expand annual passenger capacity from 19.3 million to 32 million by 2030, including upgrades to cargo and aircraft movement capabilities. The expansion aims to support Vision 2030 and strengthen the airport's role as an international hub.

stories.title: Saudi crown prince, US Central Command chief discuss latest regional developments

en.title: Saudi crown prince, US Central Command chief discuss latest regional developments
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper in Jeddah to review bilateral relations and regional developments. The Saudi Minister of State and National Security Adviser also attended the meeting.

stories.title: Crown Prince, US CENTCOM Commander discuss latest regional developments

en.title: Crown Prince, US CENTCOM Commander discuss latest regional developments
en.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman received US Central Command Commander Admiral Brad Cooper in Jeddah to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments. Saudi Minister of State and National Security Adviser Dr. Musaed bin Mohammed Al-Aiban participated in the meeting.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, CENTCOM Commander Discuss Regional Developments

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, CENTCOM Commander Discuss Regional Developments
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince held discussions with the commander of the US Central Command regarding regional matters and developments in the Middle East.

stories.title: Saudi Vice Foreign Minister, EU Gulf Envoy discuss regional and international developments

en.title: Saudi Vice Foreign Minister, EU Gulf Envoy discuss regional and international developments
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs met with the EU's Special Representative for the Gulf region to review bilateral cooperation and discuss regional matters of mutual concern.

stories.title: Saudi, UAE FMs discuss efforts to contain regional escalation

en.title: Saudi, UAE FMs discuss efforts to contain regional escalation
en.summary: The foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia and the UAE discussed ways to manage rising regional tensions and emphasized the importance of coordinating their positions on regional security.

stories.title: Pakistan PM calls Crown Prince to reaffirm full support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: Pakistan PM calls Crown Prince to reaffirm full support and solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Pakistan's Prime Minister spoke with Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince to discuss regional de-escalation efforts. Pakistan reaffirmed its support for Saudi Arabia and condemned attacks by Houthi militia against the Kingdom.

en.title: Tadawul: Major ownership changes on Sept. 10
en.summary: The Saudi stock exchange reported major ownership changes on September 10.

en.title: Riyadh Cement signs $14.9M contract
en.summary: Riyadh Cement signed a $14.9 million contract with Tianjin Cement Industry Design Research Institute for an Industrial Beacons Project. The 24-month contract covers digital transformation, automation, and process optimization initiatives.

en.title: MRNA appoints Turki Al-Baiz as CEO
en.summary: Morabaha Marina Financing Co. appointed Turki Al-Baiz as Chief Executive Officer effective October 1. Al-Baiz brings over 25 years of experience in the financial and banking sectors.

en.title: Baazeem inks SAR 4M contract with GCFF
en.summary: Baazeem Trading Co. signed a one-year distribution agreement with Gulf Catering Food Factory valued at approximately SAR 4 million annually to distribute products across Saudi Arabia, with financial impact expected by end of Q4 2026.

en.title: Tadawul sees 13 negotiated deals worth SAR 88.4M
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange recorded 13 negotiated deals totaling SAR 88.4 million on September 14, including two transactions involving 1.8 million shares of MRNA representing approximately 2.5% of the company's outstanding shares.
